name: Gripper Type Variant Selection (Disambiguation)
description: Two gripper configurations are available: vacuum cup (lighter, weaker grip) and electromechanical jaw (heavier, stronger grip). Disambiguation UPR selects between two grip force uncertainty sets based on process requirements.

uncertainty.source: Vacuum cup datasheet: grip force at 0.6–0.8 bar supply pressure

elements.name: Minimum Grip Force
elements.description: Part mass and acceleration: minimum grip force for reliable pick
